Prefer SFTP delivery or a secured Drive link; if possible include checksums. We expect to reference these artifacts in our SIG-A follow-up. If this needs an NDA amendment or additional redaction, let me know.

Hi all — attaching a compact bundle and answering the specific items below. Attachments are listed in the manifest in the Drive link; I'm pasting key points inline.

1) Operator-forwarding runbook (transit-checklist-kms-2026.md, attached):
- Operators use a role-based SSH bastion with time-limited session tokens; handoffs are done via signed shiftlog entry in our guarded audit ledger.
- Handoff steps: create signed entry -> upload checksum to guarded ledger -> receiving operator acknowledges with signed PGP token -> ticket is updated in our internal tracker.
- For emergency incidents we perform an oral escalation + signed rewrap; that triggers an immediate snapshot of the KEK usage table and an emergency rewrap procedure (see rotation-window-summary-2026.txt).

2) Sample shift logs (operator-shiftlog-2026-11.csv, redacted):
- Included anonymized operator_id, shift_start, shift_end, handoff_signature, ticket_id. We redacted emails and IPs per our sharing policy.

3) HSM attestation (hsm-attestation-2026-11.pdf):
- Vendor: FortHSM v3.2.1; FIPS-validated module; attached vendor-signed attestation and CA chain.

4) TLS config:
- Mutual TLS between hosts and KMS endpoint, TLS 1.3 only, cipher suites: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384. We disallow RSA key exchange; forward secrecy enforced.

5) Rotation windows & emergency rewraps:
- Standard rotation window: monthly KEK rotation on the first Sunday 02:00-04:00 PST with pre-flight snapshot + post-rotation verification.
- Emergency rewrap: executed on-call with cross-check from two operators and recorded in the shiftlog; rewrap is always followed by HSM-backed attestation export.

Delivery: I uploaded files to https://drive.redwood.com/shared/KB/nb-transit-evidence-2026 (read-only link, access granted to samira.khoury@northbridge.com). Checksums and a signed manifest included.

If you want additional operator interviews or a short recorded demo of the handoff, I can schedule next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
